rows.label: bf06140110_0030
rows.name:
it seems an official summit is to be
held between Superbia and Invidia.

rows.label: bf06140110_0040
rows.name:
A summit? About the battle the other day?
But wasn't that...

rows.label: bf06140110_0050
rows.name: Didn't Pope Malbeni step in and resolve it?

rows.label: bf06140110_0060
rows.name:
Perhaps there are things they don't want
the Holy See of Acedia to hear.

rows.label: bf06140110_0070
rows.name:
Besides, Invidia keeps their
distance from this place.

rows.label: bf06140110_0080
rows.name: They'd lose face if the Pope interposed.

rows.label: bf06140110_0090
rows.name:
They're probably just
keeping up appearances.

rows.label: bf06140110_0120
rows.name:
Wow, how does Turtle-chan
know such difficult words?

rows.label: bf06140110_0130
rows.name:
What's that supposed to mean, 'for a turtle'?
Shut it, cat girl.

rows.label: bf06140110_0140
rows.name:
Anyway, this summit would explain
why Meleph isn't around...

rows.label: bf06140110_0150
rows.name: Probably. I hear she's very busy.
